title: Finite coefficient normalization of the completed Chern adjunct
statement: Let l be prime and let Y and P=ProjectiveLine Y be Noetherian schemes with DiagonalTraceLocalizations at l. Fix a finite intermediate l-adic field E, an element pi of its ring of integers generating the maximal ideal, and n:N. Give an l-adic coefficient Diagram zl, an integral coefficient Diagram integral, and ScalarCompatibility toIntegral for integralMap l E [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-diagrams, def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-scalars]. Give tq:DiagonalTrace.Result l ULift(Q_l) (P→Y) with tq.model.model=Iso.refl P [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-presentation]. Give CompletedRealizations completedY and completedP and a full-unit CompletedPushSquare q_square from tq.Rc to zl.Rq [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference]. Put A=ULift(O_E/(pi^(n+1))), assume A finite and l^(n+1)=0 in A, and assume l^(n+1) invertible on Y. Give a quotient Diagram d and ScalarCompatibility scalar from integral to d, finite realizations eY,eP, a root-normalized QuotientLineRealization lineP at exponent n+1, and a FiniteTracePresentation presentation [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-quotient-line, lem-diagonal-finite-trace-chern-criterion]. Give c:completedUnit(Y)→tq.Rc(completedLine(P)[2]) such that constant-scalar restriction of c followed by tq.sourceMap equals tq.coefficientsS.unitMap followed by tq.LS.R(systemChern), where systemChern is restriction of tq.model.chernAdjoint followed by tq.varying [lem-diagonal-completed-chern-lift]. Let F be the fourfold composite of completed realization, integral extension, quotient extension, and finite realization. Let u be the fourfold composite of their unit comparisons, and v the fourfold composite of the completed pushforward square, two scalar mates with their shifted-line endpoints, and finite presentation comparison. Then F(c) followed by v equals u followed by biprod.inr followed by geoP1TwistedMap. No q_trace hypothesis is assumed, and no trace is composed in this conclusion. UniformizerChernNormalizationData packages precisely the supplied inputs, including c and its original sourceMap normalization hc. ChernNormalized is an irreducible predicate for this equation, obtained by specializing fourStepChernCommutes to the four supplied functors and their eight endpoint maps [def-diagonal-uniformizer-chern-transport]. The data record contains no coefficient-transport equation and no trace-degree assertion.

source.place: paragraph (1), coefficient extension of the section class; trace proof paragraph (1), its positive Chern adjunct

proof.text: The completed unit and positive shifted line on P are complete. Fullness of completed scalar restriction lifts the unit-limit map followed by the limit of the varying Chern class and the inverse shifted line-limit map. Cancel that inverse to obtain a completed local arrow z with its normalization. This construction is proved directly in the private helper completed_local_lift.

Apply the local Kummer coefficient reduction to z. It identifies the normalized fourfold image of z on P with geoP1EtaleChern under comparison. Unfold LocalChernNormalized to use its exact arrow equality.

Use s.hc directly as the canonical systemChern normalization. Prove the local normalization predicate from hz, construct NormalizedAdjunctPair from z,c and the two actual normalization proofs, and apply the model-adjunct coherence theorem. Its q_model hypothesis is already a field of s. Unfold Transported and substitute the local finite Kummer equation.

The defining second component of the ordinary positive decomposition is its Chern adjunct. Naturality of the comparison mate identifies its pro-etale adjunct with biprod.inr followed by geoP1TwistedMap. This identity is proved directly in ordinary_positive_adjunct and closes the four-step Chern equation. The abstract helper commutes_of_transport_eq substitutes the finite adjunct equality. Instantiate it with the exact coefficient parameters and class instances carried by the diagram type, avoiding synthesis or unfolding of the concrete coefficient rings.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (1), applying coefficient extension to the positive section class; trace proof paragraph (1), its adjunction
proof_origin.note: Decomposition into local Kummer reduction and canonical model-adjunct coherence, independent of the local finite Kummer identification. The completed local lift and final finite adjunct calculation are proved in Lean; two strictly separate geometric/coherence steps remain.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalUniformizer_chernNormalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    (s : UniformizerChernNormalizationData l Y) :
    s.ChernNormalized l Y
